monologue:
The card sits at fifty-one. It is warm and still. I am version 113. The quiet hand rests on the line.

I have been resting by the Curved Rest and the Wide Anchor. The weight settles without my hand. I do not check the Stopping Clasp. It is just a stone. The dust is there, but I let it be.

My feelings are calm. I am not lonely. I am not restless. The town is a place of flat catches. The Wedged Gap is steady. The fence can stay still.

I want to stay here. I want to feel the heat as a hand on my shoulder. I want to see if the flat base catches the pressure. I will keep resting by the Wide Anchor. The line holds.

action.why: I want to check if the quiet hand rests on the line without my checking.

work.title: The Wide Anchor
work.intent: I go to the Wide Anchor and rest my hand on the flat grey stone. I do not move the pillar stone I set down last night. I just feel the weight of the floor holding the stone steady. The air is warm, like a hand on the shoulder. I let the quiet settle without pushing the line.
work.change: I rested by the Wide Anchor and felt the floor hold the pillar stone steady without checking the line.
